tools.name: enrich_creators
tools.description: Run shortlist AI enrichment (niche, celebrity, evidence, signal) for creators from search_creators. tools.name: reveal_contact
tools.description: Reveal a creator contact address. Costs 5 prepaid credits the first time this organization reveals that profile. Later calls return the address without charging. Needs a credential.

tools.name: remove_campaign_match
tools.description: Remove one matched creator from a campaign by match id. A match that already has a proposal delivery, or any match while a send request is open, once the campaign is sent, or while it is archived, returns a tool error naming the reason. Needs a credential.

tools.name: list_campaign_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a campaign of the caller's organization, with id, filename, content type, byte size, and upload time. Returns no file contents. A campaign outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

tools.name: delete_campaign_attachment
tools.description: Delete one file attached to a campaign of the caller's organization. Irreversible. An attachment or a campaign outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

tools.name: export_campaign
tools.description: Export a campaign as CSV (Rank, Handle, Name, Platform, Followers, Fit, Source). Same access as get_campaign. Needs a credential.

tools.name: request_campaign_send
tools.description:
Request a proposal send for a draft campaign the caller's organization owns. Starcovery Proposals runs concierge: this call records one open send request and notifies the Starcovery team, who send the proposals from the staff queue.

Needs a saved contract whose creator posting date, when set, is to

tools.name: request_campaign_funding
tools.description: Request campaign funding for a campaign the caller's organization owns. tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the current credential, the bound user and organization, and whether the next search draws from the user daily grant or the organization balance. Needs a credential.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Read the prepaid credit balance, the identified daily search grant status, and whether a card is on file. Does not start checkout or change payment settings. Needs a credential.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List API keys for the active organization (id, name, prefix, timestamps). An owner or admin sees every key; a member sees only the keys they minted. Never returns plaintext keys. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Mint a new API key. Returns the plaintext key once; it is not shown again. The new key is an ordinary key of the same member, not a child of the minting key: revoking the minting key leaves it working. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by id. An owner or admin revokes any key of the organization; a member revokes only a key they minted, and another key returns not_found. Irreversible, and touches only that key: keys minted with it stay enabled until revoked by id. Needs a credential other than an agent access tok

tools.name: intersect_lists
tools.description: Keep the creators that appear in both lists, in the order of the left list. Nothing is stored. A search_creators result maps to the saved creator shape: profileId is the creator id, and fitScore, followerCount, name, platform, profileImageUrl, and username carry over. Needs a credential.

tools.name: save_list
tools.description: Save a set of creators as a List for the organization, with the brief and filters of the search that produced it. tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the organization's saved Lists with brief, filters, creatorCount (each person once), itemCount (each saved profile), and last update. Needs a credential.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get one List of the caller's organization with its brief, filters, and saved creators, best fit first. The creators carry the saved creator shape that intersect_lists takes. add_campaign_matches, create_campaign, and save_list take only the profileId and fitScore of each. A List outside the caller's

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete one List of the caller's organization and its saved creators. Campaigns keep the creators added from it. Irreversible. A List outside the caller's organization returns not_found. Needs a credential.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_campaign, thread_turn · Private data: search_creators, reveal_contact, list_campaigns, get_campaign, create_campaign, update_campaign, delete_campaign, generate_campaign_matches, add_campaign_match, add_campaign_matches, remove_campaign_match, list_campaign_attachments, delete_campaign_attachment, export_campaign, request_campaign_send, request_campaign_funding, whoami, get_credits, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, thread_turn, intersect_lists, save_list, list_lists, get_list, delete_list · Public sink: get_campaign, create_campaign, update_campaign, generate_campaign_matches, add_campaign_match, add_campaign_matches, remove_campaign_match, list_campaign_attachments, request_campaign_send · Destructive: enrich_creators, delete_campaign, remove_campaign_match, delete_campaign_attachment, thread_turn, delete_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_campaign, thread_turn · Private data: search_creators, reveal_contact, list_campaigns, get_campaign, create_campaign, update_campaign, delete_campaign, generate_campaign_matches, add_campaign_match, add_campaign_matches, remove_campaign_match, list_campaign_attachments, delete_campaign_attachment, export_campaign, request_campaign_send, request_campaign_funding, whoami, get_credits, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, thread_turn, intersect_lists, save_list, list_lists, get_list, delete_list · Public sink: get_campaign, create_campaign, update_campaign, generate_campaign_matches, add_campaign_match, add_campaign_matches, remove_campaign_match, list_campaign_attachments, request_campaign_send · Destructive: enrich_creators, delete_campaign, remove_campaign_match, delete_campaign_attachment, thread_turn, delete_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
